tool.name: OGS: editMaterialID
tool.description: Edit material IDs of mesh elements.
tool.command: ln -sf '$mesh_input_file' 'mesh_input_file.vtu'; editMaterialID #if str($mode.mode) == "replace" --replace --current-material-id '$mode.current_material_id' --new-material-id '$mode.new_material_id' #elif str($mode.mode) == "condense" --condense #elif str($mode.mode) == "specify" --specify --element-type '$mode.element_type' --new-material-id '$mode.new_material_id' #end if --mesh-input-file 'mesh_input_file.vtu' --mesh-output-file output_1.vtu

param.label: mesh input file
param.help: Input (.vtu | .msh). The name of the file containing the input mesh

param.name: mode
param.label: editing mode
param.help: OGS requires exactly one of --replace, --condense and --specify; each mode takes different arguments.
param.option: specify material ID of elements of one type

param.label: current material id
param.help: current material id to be replaced (may be repeated; the wrapper passes one value)

tool.help: Edit material IDs of mesh elements.
